name: jslib
description: TypeScript libraries and config presets published as @gpahal/*
author: Garvit Pahal <g10pahal@gmail.com>

scripts.check: turbo run build typecheck test test-recipes typecheck-root typecheck-release lint-check lint-check-root fmt-check knip --continue=dependencies-successful
scripts.clean: rm -rf .turbo .eslintcache packages/*/build packages/*/.turbo packages/*/tests/tmp packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/tests/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/tests/*/*.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*.tgz
scripts.cs-publish: ./scripts/verify-publish-ci.sh && ./scripts/verify-no-git-changes.sh && ./scripts/verify-no-ignored-files.sh && turbo run build --force && ./scripts/verify-no-git-changes.sh && JSLIB_RELEASE=1 changeset publish --no-git-tag
